description: This file defines the interface UnretireHandler for handling 'unretire' actions on Retireable objects within the OpenMRS core API. It provides a method to perform unretire operations, resetting relevant attributes on Retireable objects.

classes.name: UnretireHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling the unretire operation on Retireable objects, extending RequiredDataHandler.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Method called to reset Retireable attributes to null during unretire operation, taking a Retireable object, User, Date, and a String parameter.
